mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) generates a positive signal that is consistently associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5%

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals a weak labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 0.5% and the year-over-year CPI change is below 2.5%, it indicates a low-inflation, low-rate environment that supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5% AND CPIAUCSL_yoy_change < 2.5%

mechanism_narrative: In the regime of weak housing market (HOUST < 900), consumer demand is insufficient to support corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances where HOUST < 900

mechanism_narrative: Weak industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals a contraction in manufacturing, reducing corporate profitability and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances where INDPRO < 100

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST < 900) and retail sales (RSAFS < 400000) are both below thresholds, it indicates a weak consumer demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances where HOUST < 900 AND RSAFS < 400000

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL_yoy_change > 3.0%) signals an overheating economy, prompting monetary tightening and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL_yoy_change > 3.0%

mechanism_narrative: Weak GDP growth (GDPC1 qoq < 0.5%) signals a slowing economy, reducing corporate earnings growth and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances where GDPC1_qoq < 0.5%
